comment: Dr. Kim's class is very structured, and she's a very flexible professor. As a freshman STEM student, I had no prior knowledge of art history and was still able to adapt and thrive. Dr. Kim is an excellent professor, and I would definitely take one of her courses again.
Other comments are outdated; the syllabus was revised, and everything has changed. Impossible quiz 16 questions (6 free responses) in 10 mins once for two weeks. Boring lecture and tons of paper.

Professor Kim is really nice and her class is super easy. Despite having one paper about every two or three weeks, you can go to her office hour and receive a 100 on paper after editing what she tells you to do.I took this class for general education requirement, but I learned many interesting knowledge.
You will excell in all of her classes if you just show up, pay attention, and take good notes. I recommend taking a class with her with a smaller number of people, it is a lot better.

Very nice, super easy grader for the assignments (which there aren't many), and if you make an effort to participate in class then you'll do just fine. It is important to go to the lectures though because she will upload the  power points she uses but her lectures (which you should take notes on) are not uploaded.
